TPT2 Upgrade oven:
:name TPT2Upgrade:Stop
:budget_cap max
:global int uf_continue


key.f()
uf_continue = 0

:name TPT2Upgrade:Decode
:budget_cap max
:global string uf_data
:global int uf_cursor
:global string uf_id
:global int uf_level
:global int uf_op
:global double uf_yield
:global string uf_job
:global int uf_edges
:global string uf_row
:local string ids
:local string jobs
:local int itemIndex
:local int machineIndex

; Fixed record fields: item, tier, operation, yield, machine, edge count, edges.
ids = "12machine.oven            17machine.assembler       16machine.refinery        15machine.crusher         14machine.cutter          15machine.presser         13machine.mixer           21machine.transportbelt   14machine.shaper          14machine.boiler          04chip                    15cable.insulated         11plate.stack             05motor                   04pump                    06hammer                  05block                   05ingot                   03ore                     06rubber                  04lump                    04dust                    05plate                   11plate.dense             11block.dense             12plate.rubber            03rod                     04pipe                    04ring                    05cable                   13plate.circuit           04wire                    05screw                   07circuit                 "
jobs = "00                        04oven                    09assembler               08refinery                07crusher                 06cutter                  07presser                 05mixer                   13transportbelt           06shaper                  06boiler                  "
uf_row = sub(uf_data, uf_cursor * 33, 33)
itemIndex = s2i(sub(uf_row, 0, 2), 0)
machineIndex = s2i(sub(uf_row, 6, 2), 0)
uf_id = sub(ids, itemIndex * 26 + 2, s2i(sub(ids, itemIndex * 26, 2), 0))
uf_job = sub(jobs, machineIndex * 26 + 2, s2i(sub(jobs, machineIndex * 26, 2), 0))
uf_level = s2i(sub(uf_row, 2, 2), 0)
uf_op = s2i(sub(uf_row, 4, 1), 0)
uf_yield = s2d(sub(uf_row, 5, 1), 1.0)
uf_edges = s2i(sub(uf_row, 8, 1), 0)

:name TPT2Upgrade:Plan
:budget_cap max
:global int uf_continue
:global int uf_length
:global int uf_cursor
:global string uf_id
:global int uf_level
:global int uf_op
:global double uf_yield
:global int uf_edges
:global string uf_row
:global int uf_short
:global double uf_cost
:local double missing
:local double needed
:local double units
:local double ore
:local int slot
:local int offset
:local int child
:local double quantity
:local double work

; Propagate demand before dispatching anything. Shared inputs are reserved once.
uf_short = 0
uf_cost = 0.0
uf_cursor = 0
clear:
global.double.set("uf_need" . uf_cursor, 0.0)
global.double.set("uf_jobs" . uf_cursor, 0.0)
global.double.set("uf_ore" . uf_cursor, 0.0)
uf_cursor += 1
gotoif(clear, uf_cursor < uf_length)
global.double.set("uf_need0", 1.0)
uf_cursor = 0
node:
gotoif(end, uf_continue == 0 || isopen("factory") == false)
needed = global.double.get("uf_need" . uf_cursor)
gotoif(next, needed <= 0.0)
executesync("TPT2Upgrade:Decode")
missing = max(0.0, needed - count(uf_id, uf_level))
gotoif(raw, uf_op == 0)
gotoif(next, missing <= 0.0)
units = ceil(missing / uf_yield)
global.double.set("uf_jobs" . uf_cursor, units)
gotoif(dust, uf_op == 3)
slot = 0
edge:
offset = 9 + slot * 4
child = s2i(sub(uf_row, offset, 2), 0)
quantity = s2d(sub(uf_row, offset + 2, 2), 0.0)
global.double.set("uf_need" . child, global.double.get("uf_need" . child) + units * quantity)
slot += 1
gotoif(edge, slot < uf_edges)
goto(next)

raw:
uf_cost += needed
gotoif(next, missing <= 0.0)
uf_short = 1
goto(next)

dust:
ore = min(count("ore", uf_level), ceil(missing / 2.0))
global.double.set("uf_ore" . uf_cursor, ore)
child = s2i(sub(uf_row, 9, 2), 0)
global.double.set("uf_need" . child, global.double.get("uf_need" . child) + ore)
work = max(0.0, missing - ore * 2.0)
gotoif(next, work <= 0.0)
gotoif(no_dust, uf_edges < 2)
child = s2i(sub(uf_row, 13, 2), 0)
global.double.set("uf_need" . child, global.double.get("uf_need" . child) + work)
goto(next)
no_dust:
uf_short = 1

next:
uf_cursor += 1
gotoif(node, uf_cursor < uf_length)
end:

:name TPT2Upgrade:Batch
:budget_cap max
:global int uf_continue
:global int uf_state
:global string uf_id
:global int uf_level
:global double uf_yield
:global string uf_job
:local double before
:local double expect
:local int polls
:local string source
:local int sourceTier
:local double batch

; Inputs and expected outputs are set by Build using local variables only there.
uf_state = 4
source = global.string.get("uf_input")
sourceTier = global.int.get("uf_input_tier")
batch = global.double.get("uf_amount")
gotoif(end, uf_continue == 0 || isopen("factory") == false || batch <= 0.0)
gotoif(end, count(source, sourceTier) < batch || active(uf_job) || machine.item(uf_job) != "")
before = count(uf_id, uf_level)
expect = before + batch * uf_yield
gotoif(end, uf_continue == 0 || isopen("factory") == false)
produce(source, sourceTier, batch, uf_job)
waitframe()
gotoif(end, count(uf_id, uf_level) < expect && active(uf_job) == false && machine.item(uf_job) == "")
polls = 0
verify:
gotoif(end, uf_continue == 0 || isopen("factory") == false)
gotoif(ok, count(uf_id, uf_level) >= expect)
wait(0.25)
polls += 1
gotoif(verify, polls < 1200)
goto(end)
ok:
uf_state = 1
end:

:name TPT2Upgrade:Build
:budget_cap max
:global int uf_continue
:global int uf_length
:global int uf_cursor
:global string uf_id
:global int uf_level
:global int uf_op
:global double uf_yield
:global string uf_job
:global string uf_row
:global int uf_state
:local double batches
:local double before
:local double ore
:local double lumps
:local int saved

; Reverse the demand pass so prerequisites precede their consumers.
uf_state = 1
uf_cursor = uf_length - 1
node:
gotoif(failed, uf_continue == 0 || isopen("factory") == false)
gotoif(done, uf_cursor <= 0)
batches = global.double.get("uf_jobs" . uf_cursor)
gotoif(next, batches <= 0.0)
executesync("TPT2Upgrade:Decode")
gotoif(dust, uf_op == 3)
gotoif(produce_part, uf_op == 2)
before = count(uf_id, uf_level)
gotoif(failed, uf_continue == 0 || isopen("factory") == false)
craft(uf_id, uf_level, batches)
waitframe()
gotoif(failed, count(uf_id, uf_level) < before + batches)
goto(next)

produce_part:
saved = uf_cursor
global.double.set("uf_amount", batches)
uf_cursor = s2i(sub(uf_row, 9, 2), 0)
executesync("TPT2Upgrade:Decode")
global.string.set("uf_input", uf_id)
global.int.set("uf_input_tier", uf_level)
uf_cursor = saved
executesync("TPT2Upgrade:Decode")
executesync("TPT2Upgrade:Batch")
gotoif(failed, uf_state != 1)
goto(next)

dust:
ore = global.double.get("uf_ore" . uf_cursor)
lumps = max(0.0, batches - 2.0 * ore)
gotoif(mix, ore <= 0.0)
uf_job = "crusher"
uf_yield = 2.0
global.double.set("uf_amount", ore)
global.string.set("uf_input", "ore")
global.int.set("uf_input_tier", uf_level)
executesync("TPT2Upgrade:Batch")
gotoif(failed, uf_state != 1)
mix:
gotoif(next, lumps <= 0.0)
uf_job = "mixer"
uf_yield = 1.0
global.double.set("uf_amount", lumps)
global.string.set("uf_input", "lump")
global.int.set("uf_input_tier", uf_level - 1)
executesync("TPT2Upgrade:Batch")
gotoif(failed, uf_state != 1)

next:
uf_cursor -= 1
goto(node)
failed:
uf_state = 4
done:

:name TPT2Upgrade:Finish
:budget_cap max
:global int uf_continue
:global int uf_candidate
:global int uf_goal
:global int uf_cursor
:global string uf_id
:global int uf_state
:global string uf_note
:local string slot
:local string table
:local int polls
:local int previous

uf_state = 4
table = "00                        04oven                    09assembler               08refinery                07crusher                 06cutter                  07presser                 05mixer                   13transportbelt           06shaper                  06boiler                  "
slot = sub(table, uf_candidate * 26 + 2, s2i(sub(table, uf_candidate * 26, 2), 0))
uf_cursor = 0
executesync("TPT2Upgrade:Decode")
gotoif(fail, uf_continue == 0 || isopen("factory") == false)
gotoif(installed, machine.tier(slot) == uf_goal)
gotoif(install, count(uf_id, uf_goal) >= 1.0)
previous = uf_goal - 1
gotoif(craft_machine, previous == 0)
uf_note = "Move " . uf_id . " T" . previous . " from its slot to inventory"
polls = 0
remove:
gotoif(fail, uf_continue == 0 || isopen("factory") == false)
gotoif(craft_machine, count(uf_id, previous) >= 1.0 && machine.tier(slot) != previous)
wait(0.25)
polls += 1
gotoif(remove, polls < 1200)
goto(fail)

craft_machine:
gotoif(fail, uf_continue == 0 || isopen("factory") == false)
craft(uf_id, uf_goal, 1.0)
waitframe()
gotoif(fail, count(uf_id, uf_goal) < 1.0 && machine.tier(slot) != uf_goal)
install:
uf_note = "Install " . uf_id . " T" . uf_goal
polls = 0
confirm:
gotoif(fail, uf_continue == 0 || isopen("factory") == false)
gotoif(installed, machine.tier(slot) == uf_goal)
wait(0.25)
polls += 1
gotoif(confirm, polls < 1200)
goto(fail)
installed:
uf_state = 2
uf_note = "Installed " . uf_id . " T" . uf_goal
fail:

:name TPT2Upgrade:Choose
:budget_cap max
:global int uf_scope
:global int uf_cap
:global int uf_base
:global int uf_selected
:global int uf_wanted
:global int uf_candidate
:global int uf_goal
:global int uf_continue
:global int uf_loaded
:global int uf_short
:global double uf_cost
:global string uf_note
:local int index
:local int tier
:local int lowest
:local int last
:local double best
:local string slots
:local string names
:local string slot

slots = "00                        04oven                    09assembler               08refinery                07crusher                 06cutter                  07presser                 05mixer                   13transportbelt           06shaper                  06boiler                  "
names = "00                        04oven                    08assembly                07refiner                 07crusher                 06cutter                  07presser                 05mixer                   04belt                    06shaper                  06boiler                  "
index = max(1, uf_scope)
last = if(uf_scope == 0, 10, uf_scope)

; A selected machine stays selected through the configured cap.
gotoif(scan_init, uf_selected == 0)
slot = sub(slots, uf_selected * 26 + 2, s2i(sub(slots, uf_selected * 26, 2), 0))
tier = machine.tier(slot)
gotoif(scan_init, tier >= uf_cap)
uf_candidate = uf_selected
uf_goal = if(tier == 0, uf_wanted, tier + 1)
goto(end)

scan_init:
uf_selected = 0
uf_candidate = 0
uf_goal = 0
lowest = uf_cap
best = 1.0e99
scan:
gotoif(end, uf_continue == 0 || isopen("factory") == false)
slot = sub(slots, index * 26 + 2, s2i(sub(slots, index * 26, 2), 0))
tier = machine.tier(slot)
gotoif(invalid, tier < 0 || tier > 10 || (tier == 0 && uf_base == 0))
gotoif(next, tier >= uf_cap || tier > lowest)
gotoif(cost, tier == lowest)
lowest = tier
uf_selected = 0
best = 1.0e99

cost:
uf_goal = tier + 1
uf_loaded = 0
executesync("TPT2Upgrade:" . sub(names, index * 26 + 2, s2i(sub(names, index * 26, 2), 0)) . "_T" . uf_goal)
gotoif(invalid, uf_loaded == 0)
executesync("TPT2Upgrade:Plan")
gotoif(end, uf_continue == 0 || isopen("factory") == false)
gotoif(next, uf_short != 0 || uf_cost >= best)
uf_selected = index
best = uf_cost

next:
index += 1
gotoif(scan, index <= last)
gotoif(complete, lowest == uf_cap)
gotoif(shortage, uf_selected == 0)
uf_candidate = uf_selected
slot = sub(slots, uf_candidate * 26 + 2, s2i(sub(slots, uf_candidate * 26, 2), 0))
uf_goal = machine.tier(slot) + 1
goto(end)

invalid:
uf_selected = 0
uf_candidate = 0
uf_note = "Check tier or missing recipe: " . slot
goto(end)
shortage:
uf_note = "Missing materials for installed tier " . lowest
goto(end)
complete:
uf_note = "Configured cap reached"
end:

:name TPT2Upgrade:Master
:budget_cap max
:global int uf_scope
:global int uf_base
:global int uf_cap
:global int uf_busy
:global int uf_continue
:global int uf_candidate
:global int uf_goal
:global int uf_wanted
:global int uf_loaded
:global int uf_short
:global int uf_state
:global string uf_note
:global int uf_selected
:local string names

key.j()
gotoif(end, uf_busy == 1 || isopen("factory") == false)
uf_busy = 1
uf_continue = 1
uf_note = "Factory planning"
wait(0.5)
gotoif(exit, uf_continue == 0)
executesync("TPT2Upgrade:Config")
names = "00                        04oven                    08assembly                07refiner                 07crusher                 06cutter                  07presser                 05mixer                   04belt                    06shaper                  06boiler                  "

cycle:
gotoif(exit, uf_continue == 0 || isopen("factory") == false)
gotoif(wait_idle, active("oven") || active("assembler") || active("refinery") || active("crusher") || active("cutter") || active("presser") || active("mixer") || active("shaper") || active("boiler"))
executesync("TPT2Upgrade:Choose")
gotoif(exit, uf_candidate == 0 || uf_continue == 0 || uf_goal < 1 || uf_goal > uf_cap)
uf_wanted = uf_goal
uf_loaded = 0
executesync("TPT2Upgrade:" . sub(names, uf_candidate * 26 + 2, s2i(sub(names, uf_candidate * 26, 2), 0)) . "_T" . uf_goal)
gotoif(missing, uf_loaded == 0)
executesync("TPT2Upgrade:Plan")
gotoif(exit, uf_continue == 0 || isopen("factory") == false)
gotoif(shortage, uf_short != 0)
executesync("TPT2Upgrade:Build")
gotoif(failed, uf_state != 1)
executesync("TPT2Upgrade:Finish")
gotoif(exit, uf_state != 2)
goto(cycle)

wait_idle:
uf_note = "Waiting for Factory machines to finish current jobs"
wait(0.25)
goto(cycle)

missing:
uf_note = "Missing upgrade script"
goto(exit)
shortage:
uf_note = "Missing materials for selected target T" . uf_goal
goto(exit)
failed:
uf_note = "Production interrupted or a batch failed to complete"
exit:
gotoif(cleanup, uf_continue != 0)
uf_note = "Stopped"
cleanup:
uf_busy = 0
end:

:name TPT2Upgrade:Config
:budget_cap max
:global int uf_scope
:global int uf_base
:global int uf_cap
:global int uf_selected

; Limit actual execution to T6 until the save can support higher tiers.
; Set cap to an unlocked tier up to T10 before exporting.
uf_cap = 6
gotoif(ready, uf_scope == 1)
uf_selected = 0
ready:
uf_scope = 1
uf_base = 1
